title: Understanding P-Trap Seal Integrity and Venting
description: A P-trap relies on a standing water seal to block dangerous sewer gases from entering living spaces. However, if the trap arm is pitched incorrectly or installed without adequate venting, the liquid discharge creates a siphon effect that pulls the water seal out of the trap body. Without that essential liquid barrier, sewer odors freely pass through the fixture drain. To protect trap seal integrity, ensure the trap arm length meets code relative to pipe diameter, maintain proper pitch, and provide adequate atmospheric venting to equalize drainage pressure.

Understanding P-Trap Seal Integrity and Venting

A P-trap relies on a standing water seal to block dangerous sewer gases from entering living spaces. However, if the trap arm is pitched incorrectly or installed without adequate venting, the liquid discharge creates a siphon effect that pulls the water seal out of the trap body. Without that essential liquid barrier, sewer odors freely pass through the fixture drain. To protect trap seal integrity, ensure the trap arm length meets code relative to pipe diameter, maintain proper pitch, and provide adequate atmospheric venting to equalize drainage pressure.
